title: SUMMARIZE returns the combinations of several group-by columns that exist in the table

source.quote: you should use SUMMARIZE only to obtain the list of unique years and colors for which there is at least a row in the Sales table
source.supports: only combinations with at least one Sales row are returned

derivation: Sales rows as (product, customer country): 1 Bike US, 2 Helmet US, 3 Helmet US, 4 Lock US, 5 Bike JP, 6 Lock JP, 7 Bike US. Distinct pairs: Bike US, Helmet US, Lock US, Bike JP, Lock JP. Helmet JP, anything FR and Scooter do not occur.
